author: Carlos Martinez
title: Belgian GP 2025 at Spa: My Grandstand Clips
description: My phone clips from the 2025 F1 Belgian Grand Prix at Spa-Francorchamps, filmed from the grandstand at La Source.

sections.p: This page is about the 2025 F1 Belgian Grand Prix weekend at Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps, in Stavelot, Belgium. Spa has the longest lap on the F1 calendar, 7.004 km.
I filmed everything here myself, on my phone, from the grandstand. On race day I sat in the Gold 7 grandstand at the La Source hairpin.
The sprint ran on Saturday, July 26, and Max Verstappen won it.
Race day was Sunday, July 27. Rain held the start for about 80 minutes, then Oscar Piastri won the race.

list: The valley around Eau Rouge and Raidillon, with its red and yellow kerbs.
A Kick Sauber and an Aston Martin below my seat.
Splits that compare the real Eau Rouge with iRacing.

sections.p: One clip needs a note. Spa-Francorchamps From the Grandstand is my most viewed Short of any kind, with about 30,000 views. It is a raw 13-second view from the stands, filmed on Sunday before the F1 start.
If you want to take Spa to the sim, I wrote a guide: driving Spa in iRacing. The splits that compare the real Eau Rouge with iRacing are a good place to start before you read it.

faqs.q: Where did you film the 2025 Belgian GP clips?
faqs.a: On my phone, from the grandstand at Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps in Stavelot, Belgium. On race day I sat in the Gold 7 grandstand at the La Source hairpin.

faqs.q: Who won the 2025 Belgian GP weekend races?
faqs.a: Max Verstappen won the sprint on Saturday, July 26. Oscar Piastri won the race on Sunday, July 27, after rain held the start for about 80 minutes.

faqs.q: How long is a lap of Spa?
faqs.a: 7.004 km, the longest lap on the F1 calendar.
